stable.message: No stable release yet. Please use beta or dev.

beta.name: rasqberry-beta-2026-10-07
highlights: Now on Raspberry Pi OS Trixie (Debian 13), with Python 3.13 and the current Qiskit

A/B image: the SD card stays in the Pi. New releases install over the air and keep your settings, Wi-Fi, LED setup and Raspberry Pi Connect; the Pi falls back by itself if one doesn't work (64 GB+, 128 GB recommended)
Raspberry Pi Imager: your password, Wi-Fi, SSH key, keyboard and Raspberry Pi Connect are applied (the user name stays rasqberry)
Taskbar badge shows which system runs, what's new in a release, and when the Pi's firmware is outdated
Demos: Workshop & Qiskit Server, Qiskit Tutorials, Quantum Lab, Fun with Quantum, learning paths and a demo catalogue; each pinned to a tested version, and all stop the same way
16 GB cards run every demo except the Docker ones (32 GB or more)
